persona: Plant HR executive at a unionised auto parts plant moving into a full IR role
resumeText:
Arvind Yadav | Gurugram | arvind.yadav@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Executive - Plant HR, Aravali Auto Components Ltd, Manesar (2020 - present)
- Handled shop-floor grievances of 900 workmen and met union representatives every week.
- Drafted charge sheets and show cause notices for misconduct cases under certified standing orders.
- Audited 14 labour contractors for licences, wage registers and PF and ESI payments.
- Maintained Factories Act registers and filed annual and half-yearly returns.
- Ran the canteen committee and works committee meetings each month.
- Prepared wage cost data for management ahead of the wage talks with the union.

HR Trainee, Aravali Auto Components Ltd, Manesar (2019 - 2020)
- Supported the time office with attendance and overtime records.

EDUCATION
MBA (HR), Maharshi Dayanand University, Rohtak, 2019
BA, University of Delhi, 2017

SKILLS
Labour law compliance, Wage settlements, MS Excel, greytHR
